record:
p="$HOME/.gespann-recording"
command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ffmpeg is not installed on the sandbox's machine" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ] || { echo "the sandbox has no screen (DISPLAY is not set)" >&2; exit 1; }
p="$HOME/.gespann-recording"
r="$(cat "$p.pid" 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$r" ] && kill -TERM "$r" 2>/dev/null; then i=0; while kill -0 "$r" 2>/dev/null && [ $i -lt 300 ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done; kill -KILL "$r" 2>/dev/null; fi
rm -f "$p.pid"
true
mkdir -p "$(dirname '/home/user')"; rm -f '/home/user'
s="$(command -v setsid || true)"
nohup $s ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -f x11grab -draw_mouse 1 -framerate 5 -i "$DISPLAY" -vf "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2" -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 32 -pix_fmt yuv420p '/home/user' > "$p.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo $! > "$p.pid"
sleep 1
kill -0 "$(cat "$p.pid")" 2>/dev/null || { echo "ffmpeg stopped right away: $(tail -c 300 "$p.log")" >&2; rm -f "$p.pid"; exit 1; }

finishRecording:
test -s '/home/user' || exit 0
o="$(ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -i '/home/user' -vf blackdetect=d=1:pix_th=0.02:pic_th=0.999 -an -f null - 2>&1)"
b="$(printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -o 'black_start:0 black_end:[0-9.]*' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f3)"
d="$(printf '%s\n' "$o" | sed -n 's/.*Duration: \([0-9]*\):\([0-9]*\):\([0-9.]*\).*/\1 \2 \3/p' | head -n 1 | awk '{ print $1 * 3600 + $2 * 60 + $3 }')"
{ [ -n "$b" ] && [ -n "$d" ] && awk -v b="$b" -v d="$d" 'BEGIN { exit !(b < d - 0.5) }' && ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -ss "$b" -i '/home/user' -an -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 32 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart '/home/user.tmp.mp4' && test -s '/home/user.tmp.mp4'; } ||
  ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i '/home/user' -c copy -movflags +faststart '/home/user.tmp.mp4' ||
  { rm -f '/home/user.tmp.mp4'; exit 0; }
test -s '/home/user.tmp.mp4' && mv '/home/user.tmp.mp4' '/home/user'
rm -f '/home/user.tmp.mp4'

screen:
f='/home/user/.gespann-display'
if [ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ] || ! command -v Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$f" "$f.pid" "$f.size"; exit 0; fi
size="$(grep -xE '[0-9]{3,4}x[0-9]{3,4}x24' '/home/user/.gespann-screen' 2>/dev/null || echo 1440x900x24)"
if [ -s "$f" ] && [ -s "$f.pid" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$f.pid")" 2>/dev/null; then
  [ "$(cat "$f.size" 2>/dev/null || echo 1440x900x24)" = "$size" ] && exit 0
  kill "$(cat "$f.pid")" 2>/dev/null
fi
rm -f "$f" "$f.pid" "$f.n" "$f.size"
s="$(command -v setsid || true)"
nohup $s Xvfb -displayfd 3 -screen 0 "$size" -nolisten tcp 3> "$f.n" > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo $! > "$f.pid"
echo "$size" > "$f.size"
i=0; while [ ! -s "$f.n" ] && [ $i -lt 100 ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done
n="$(tr -dc 0-9 < "$f.n")"; rm -f "$f.n"
if [ -z "$n" ]; then kill "$(cat "$f.pid")" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$f.pid"; echo "Xvfb did not start" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo ":$n" > "$f"
